描述_ZN: A black-flowered, waist-round pillow with baby-play motif on a white ground, Song dynasty, 10.4 cm high, 29.9 cm long, 22.5 cm wide.　　The pillow has a low front and high back. The entire body is covered with white glaze and the pillow is decorated with black color on the face and sides. The border of the pillow is decorated with double lines outlining string patterns and ruyi-shaped openings, and four groups of scrolling branches between the string patterns and the openings. Two infants are standing opposite each other, one of them with a small bird on its head, and the other one looks excited and wants to catch the bird. The side of the pillow is painted with a simple flower and grass pattern.　　　　There are many objects decorated with the theme of infant play, such as catching ducks in a pond, playing gyro, cueball, horseback riding, fishing, and firecrackers. Whether it is a game, playing with lotus or catching ducks, a few strokes, the child's innocent, cute childlike interest is expressed. This pillow, although not much ink, simple brushwork, but vivid and subtle.
